summary: The reclaim held and the trend extended. NQ (+0.61%) and ES (+0.60%) both stayed above their rising ATR stops, printed fresh session highs, and closed near the top on a quiet, no-news risk-on day, with the VIX down about 5% to 14.9. Under the surface rotation kept working: gold reclaimed its own stop and flipped bullish while crude lost its stop and fell 2.4%.

risk.note: Throttle upgraded to NORMAL. Thursday's path back was MNQ holding above 30,530 and MES above 7,731 on Friday, and both did, closing above rising stops with the VIX back to 14.9. Trend longs can re-engage at measured size. Two cautions: do not chase near the highs into a quiet weekend, and the week back-loads with August PCE, Q2 GDP and quarter-end all on Wednesday Sep 30. Keep size measured into that print.

psychology: Trend days after a scary flush are where discipline pays. Yesterday you wanted proof the bounce was real; today the reclaim held and patience got paid. The trap now flips: after a clean up day it feels safe to chase, and chasing near the highs into a quiet weekend with the stop far below is how good weeks give back gains. Let price come to you. The edge is buying strength on a pullback to support, not paying up at the top of the range.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN (MNQ)
fullReport.html:
Opening range: high 30,890.25, low 30,767.25, width 123 points (about 0.40%).

Break: UP at 13:45 UTC (9:45 ET), first close above the range at 30,900.

NYVWAP: 30,863 (typical-price VWAP; volume is disclaimed on a continuous contract).

Signals fired: None qualified. The up-break failed straight back through the range to the 30,684 low, then price rebuilt and closed at the highs. The short-only Hand-off did not apply to an up-break, and the whipsaw gave no clean reclaim signal.

Filter state: Friday, no CPI or FOMC. All four plays were eligible; the two-way open handed none of them a clean setup.

Lesson: An opening-range break that fails back through the range in the first hour is a whipsaw warning. Wait for acceptance, two hourly closes beyond the range, before trusting direction.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout (Regime Filter)
fullReport.html:
Signal: No signal fired.

ROC(12): about minus 0.1% over the last twelve hours, flat momentum despite the higher close.

50-EMA / regime filter: No longer blocking. Price is back above the 50-EMA near 30,792 for the first time since the flush, so the long is no longer suppressed. That is why E3v2 moved from blocked to borderline.

Note: Relative volume is disclaimed on a continuous contract. The breakout long stays parked until a real volume and momentum thrust shows above the 50-EMA.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band Reversal (MNQ)
fullReport.html:
AVWAP center: 30,851.

Bands: plus 2 sigma 30,913, plus 3 sigma 30,944; minus 2 sigma 30,788, minus 3 sigma 30,757 (1 sigma about 31 points).

Price zone: stretched, closed near plus 2 sigma (30,922).

Note: A close pinned near plus 2 sigma on a trend-up day is extension, not exhaustion. Mean reversion is not the play; fading a trending tape at the upper band is how these setups fail.
